start: HQ app, a lead who wants a gym

steps.action: Make a gym with gym name, owner name and mobile
user_sees: The gym, its join code, and the owner's 6-digit code with when it ends (30 minutes), shown once
must_not: The code written into the audit log

steps.action: The owner signs in with the code

start: HQ app, a gym with 4 live devices and one old owner key

steps.action: Sign every device of the gym out, with a reason
user_sees: 4 devices ended, 1 old owner key counted, not removed

steps.action: Make a gym with a bad mobile, or an empty owner name
must_not: A gym made with no owner

steps.action: Sign a gym out with no reason
must_not: Devices ended with no reason written

start: HQ app, a gym just signed out

steps.action: A desk device of the gym opens the admin app

start: A gym HQ made and later signed out

user_sees: 'create_gym' and 'sign_out_gym' listed with time and reason
must_not: The owner's full code or mobile in the audit details
